en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Biin Hakeym, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al Waleed Bin Sabeeh, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘But rather, the body is built upon the bread’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ali ibn af-Hassan al-Tamimiy from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad Hakim from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al- Hamid from af-Wafid ibn Sabih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The body is made out of bread (food).”’
